scope: Four administrative-area and three residence-specific analyses; Sindh district-only.

interpretation: Weighted percentages, primary classifications, model populations, coefficients and administrative-area CR2 inference match the previous analyses to numerical tolerance. Supply display sign and SD maps intentionally change. Descriptive intervals follow ids=~1 and no strata; Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire and Sindh intervals change. This does not reconstruct the original full survey design or propagate uncertainty in estimated area scores.

standard_runner_validation.mode: Both joins and all seven current main analyses were rebuilt from the complete input ZIP. The standard runner resumed after the verified main stage to rebuild all eight supporting reports and three historical outputs and validate all 18 reports.
